title: Country-related cooperation programme with Argentina (ALEARG)
summary: Funding for graduates, doctoral candidates, and postdocs from Argentina to complete study or research stays or Master's/doctoral degrees in Germany, including language courses and financial support.

degree_levels.notes: Supports Master's, postgraduate courses, doctoral studies, and research stays.

subject_areas.notes: All disciplines are eligible; preparatory German course specified for humanities, economics, and law.

nationality.notes: Applicants must be of Argentine nationality.

residence.notes: Applicants must be living in and applying from Argentina.

mandatory.text: Graduates, doctoral candidates, postdocs or teachers at universities in Argentina or researchers at publicly funded institutions of Argentine nationality
Usually up to the age of 36
Postdocs must have finished their doctoral studies no longer than 3 years previously

preferences.text: Quality of doctoral or research project

funding.description: Basic monthly payments of 1120 euros, monthly top-up payments of 180 euros, travel allowance, initial study and research allowance, rent subsidy, allowances for spouse and children according to DAAD guidelines, medical, accident and personal liability insurance, intensive German language course, and preparatory German course.
funding.duration: Graduates: up to two years; Doctoral candidates: 1 year or 2 to 6-month short-term; Postdocs: 1 year or 2 to 6-month research visit

application_rounds.notes: No specific deadlines are stated on the page.

steps.text: Submit applications via the online portal of the Argentinian Ministry of Education

sources.title: Country-related cooperation programme with Argentina (ALEARG) - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The programme supports international graduates, doctoral candidates, and postdocs for study and research stays physically in Germany.
